title: What did the data measure?
lines: A model trained on medical spending may learn who gets care rather than who needs it.
Bias in AI begins with the human choices already recorded inside apparently neutral data.

emotionalPlan.purpose: Anchor the opening in two distinct concepts, care received and care needed; do not fabricate numerical outcomes.
voiceDirections: Speak with clear surprise; give gentle emphasis to who needs it. Keep a natural conversational voice, let the listener picture this specific situation, and leave a real pause at the end.
Speak with grounded interest; give gentle emphasis to human choices. Keep a natural conversational voice, let the listener picture this specific situation, and leave a real pause at the end.

title: The history inside a dataset
lines: Hospital records, hiring decisions, and speech samples each leave some experiences easier to see than others.
The book follows how those differences move from records into predictions and decisions about people's lives.

emotionalPlan.purpose: Keep source-record pathways visible and reduce the number of proxy examples.
voiceDirections: Speak with thoughtful concern; give gentle emphasis to some experiences. Keep a natural conversational voice, let the listener picture this specific situation, and leave a real pause at the end.
Speak with serious clarity; give gentle emphasis to people's lives. Keep a natural conversational voice, let the listener picture this specific situation, and leave a real pause at the end.

title: Who disappears in the average?
lines: A strong average score can conceal failures for people whose circumstances rarely reach the dataset.
Removing a sensitive label does not automatically remove the information connected to it.

emotionalPlan.purpose: Retain a missing representation region rather than a misleading invented score chart.
voiceDirections: Speak with quiet concern; give gentle emphasis to rarely reach the dataset. Keep a natural conversational voice, let the listener picture this specific situation, and leave a real pause at the end.
Speak with careful contrast; give gentle emphasis to does not automatically. Keep a natural conversational voice, let the listener picture this specific situation, and leave a real pause at the end.

title: Begin before training
lines: These examples make fairness a concrete question about what a system learns and whom it serves.
Start with how a dataset was made, before the model has learned anything at all.

emotionalPlan.purpose: End with the dataset’s origin under inspection beside the opening reader.
voiceDirections: Speak with engaged inquiry; give gentle emphasis to whom it serves. Keep a natural conversational voice, let the listener picture this specific situation, and leave a real pause at the end.
